 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Celtic are in UEFA Europa League action tonight when they play host to Turkish side, Besiktas, with the Hoops looking for their first league phase points this season.
 And Martin O'Neill has made five changes from the team which started against Falkirk last weekend, with both Kasper Hogh and Benjamin Nygren returning to the starting XI.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kick-off at Celtic Park is 8pm and you can follow the build-up and all the action on the club website's Match Centre. 
 MATCH CENTRE 
 CELTIC: Johnstone, Lotomba, Carter-Vickers, Scales, Tierney, McGregor, Baur, Nygren, Forrest, Hogh, Tounekti.Subs: Sinisalo, Doohan, Duran, McCowan, Sorensen, Osmand, Oxlade-Chamberlain, Hassan, McCardle, Murray, Donovan, Ralston
